title: Participants map route has no direct test coverage
reasoning: The owned route exposes a network-facing, parameterized participants map endpoint, but the included fast view tests cover list, feast-date lookup, and serializer day-number behavior only. There is no included test that resolves or calls /api/fasts/<fast_id>/participants/map/, so regressions in URL wiring, fast_id handling, authentication/permission expectations, or response shape could ship unnoticed.
recommendation: Add a focused test for the participants map endpoint that exercises the URL path with a real fast_id and asserts the intended status code and response schema for at least the normal authorized/allowed case, plus any expected not-found or unauthenticated behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests in hub/tests/test_fast_views.py instantiate and validate other fast views, but none reference FastParticipantsMapView, the fast-participants-map URL name, or the participants/map path.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test in hub/tests/test_fast_views.py using Django/DRF test client to GET /api/fasts/<fast.id>/participants/map/ and assert the expected response fields and status.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the route and its intended API contract.
